description: Search the cities directory by name prefix with population-ranked results. Use this when an agent needs to resolve a partial city name into a canonical city slug plus state slug plus lat/lng before composing valet_find_operators_in_city or valet_find_operators_near. Empty array if no matches.

limit.description: Max results to return; default 8, capped at 25

query.description: Partial or full city name (>=2 chars). Matched against name and lowercase name fields with prefix semantics.

name: valet_search_cities

cities.description: Cities matching the query, ranked by text match then population desc

lat.description: City centroid latitude; null if unset in the index

lng.description: City centroid longitude; null if unset in the index

population.description: Census population estimate; used as the sort tiebreaker

state_slug.description: Canonical kebab-case state slug (e.g. texas, new-york)

indexed_at.description: Date the cities collection was last fully reindexed

source.description: Origin of the data; for this tool: typesense:cities

title: Search Cities
